{{Short description|French marine biologist}}
'''Jean Vacelet''' is a French marine [[biologist]] who specialises in the underwater fauna of the Mediterranean.<ref name="persee">{{Cite web|title=Vacelet, Jean - Persée|url=https://www.persee.fr/authority/652025|access-date=2020-09-25|website=www.persee.fr}}</ref> After earning his licence at the  [[Aix-Marseille University|Faculté des Sciences de Marseille]] and learning to dive in 1954, he specialised in the study of sponges at the [[Marine Station of Endoume|Marine station of Endoume]], and there he has stayed faithful to both sponges and place for more than half a century. His research has included all aspects of sponges: taxonomy,  [[habitat]], biology, anatomy, their bacterial associations,  and their place in the evolution of multi-celled animals. He has studied them not only in the Mediterranean but in the Indian Ocean and the Pacific. Exploration of underwater grottoes,<ref>{{Cite journal|author=Laborel, J.|author2=Vacelet, J.|name-list-style=amp|date=1958|title=Etude des peuplements d'une grotte sous-marine du Golfe de Marseille|journal=Bulletin de l'Institut océanographique de Monaco|volume=55|issue=1120|pages=1–20}}</ref> together with [[Jacques Laborel]] and Jo Hamelin, revealed the existence of sponges dating from very ancient geological periods and the unexpected existence of carnivorous sponges,<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=Jean VACELET|url=https://doris.ffessm.fr/Utilisateurs/Inscrits/Jean-VACELET|access-date=2020-09-25|website=doris.ffessm.fr|archive-date=2020-09-22|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200922164637/https://doris.ffessm.fr/Utilisateurs/Inscrits/Jean-VACELET}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Crew|first=B.|title=New carnivorous harp sponge discovered in deep sea|url=https://blogs.scientificamerican.com/running-ponies/new-carnivorous-harp-sponge-discovered-in-deep-sea/|access-date=2020-09-26|website=Scientific American Blog Network|language=en}}</ref> and surprisingly, the grottoes in some ways mimicked life at much greater depths.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2017-09-05|title=A La Ciotat, une grotte reproduit les conditions des grands fonds et dévoile des espèces rares|url=https://www.laprovence.com/article/mer/4604025/nos-grands-fonds-marins-a-portee-de-palmes.html|access-date=2020-09-26|website=LaProvence.com|language=fr}}</ref>

He earned one doctorate in 1958 and his doctorat ès-sciences, under Professor Claude Lévi<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|last=Futura|title=Jean Vacelet|url=https://www.futura-sciences.com/planete/personnalites/meduse-jean-vacelet-269/|access-date=2020-09-26|website=Futura|language=fr}}</ref> in 1964.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2009-02-06|title=renseignements personnel Jean VACELET: DIMAR|url=http://com.univ-mrs.fr/DIMAR/admin/detailperso.php?nom=Jean:VACELET|access-date=2020-09-26|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090206154025/http://com.univ-mrs.fr/DIMAR/admin/detailperso.php?nom=Jean:VACELET|archive-date=2009-02-06}}</ref>
